name: burrow-chat
description: Claude Code backend for the Burrow chat panel — the default chat participant, Claude models in the picker, and editor entry points.

scripts.test: node test/contextFilter.test.js && node test/styleImports.test.js && node test/packModel.test.js

chatParticipants.name: burrow
chatParticipants.description: Ask about your code, or let the agent work on it

commands.name: explain
commands.description: Explain the attached code or selection

commands.name: fix
commands.description: Propose a fix for the attached code or diagnostics

commands.name: review
commands.description: Review the attached code for defects and improvements

commands.name: tests
commands.description: Generate tests for the attached code

commands.name: doc
commands.description: Write documentation for the attached code

commands.name: init
commands.description: Generate CLAUDE.md agent instructions for this workspace

burrow.chat.cliPath.markdownDescription: Path to the `claude` CLI. Leave empty to resolve from PATH and the usual install locations.

burrow.chat.workbenchContext.description: Tell the model what the Burrow workbench is showing (isolated component and its stylesheet, live database connection, routes through the active file). Paths only, re-sent within a session only when it changes.

enumDescriptions: Follow the chat Approvals control: Default asks in chat, Auto Approve approves everything.
Claude Code plan mode: read-only analysis, no edits or commands.
Auto-approve file edits; everything else asks.
Never ask. Equivalent to the CLI's bypassPermissions.
burrow.chat.permissionMode.description: How tool permissions are decided for Claude Code runs.
